### Best courses by use case

- **Best for Jungian depth:** **Encounters with the Shadow** on Jung Platform is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[5][12]
- **Best for structured self-study:** **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** emphasizes a reflective journey of self-understanding inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development.[3]
- **Best for a spiritual-practice blend:** **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** includes lessons, exercises, diagrams, meditations, prayers, and spiritual practices.[15]
- **Best for a guided transformational program:** **Embracing the Shadow** is presented as a transformative course focused on uncovering and integrating hidden parts of the self.[4][19]
- **Best for practical technique building:** **Shadow Work Essentials** focuses on techniques to uncover and heal shamed, shunned, or exiled parts of the subconscious.[7]
- **Best for a more applied practitioner track:** **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** appears designed as a certificate-style training with lifetime access noted in the listing.[9]

### My practical recommendation

- Choose **Jung Platform** if you want the most clearly **Jungian** framing.[5][12]
- Choose **Embracing the Shadow** if you want a more **transformational, teacher-led** experience.[4][19]
- Choose **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** if you want shadow work tied directly to **spiritual exercises** like prayer and meditation.[15]
- Choose **Shadow Mastery Diploma** if you want a more formal-feeling **online program** with a reflective structure.[3]
